messages.text:
https://chaos-tarot.com/ie

Review this project and I want you to formulate a prompt I can feed into Gemini to get a v9 proposal from a different perspective, something that accomplishes the GOALS and what we want from LoA and the Infinity Engine but without copying what we've already tried, I want a radically novel approach the next iteration and evolution of a whole ass game engine built purely on maths and systems running the hardware to the best of its ability and thinking outside the box in terms of simulation and dimensionality. Our current substrate is 4D but what about even MORE spacial dimensions? Is rust even still the best language based on everything we've learned from all 8 versions of the substrate? I want to find out and I want another perspective from Google Gemini.
